description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'AbstractHiveMqttClientFactory' which provides common functionality for creating and configuring MQTT client instances (both MQTT 3 and MQTT 5). It includes methods to set up authentication, SSL/TLS configuration, and connection properties based on provided connection parameters and protocol schemes.

classes.name: AbstractHiveMqttClientFactory
classes.description: Provides common configuration methods for MQTT client builders, including setting up SSL, authentication, and reconnection policies for MQTT3 and MQTT5 clients.

methods.name: configureSimpleAuth
methods.description: Configures MQTT simple authentication credentials for MQTT 3 or MQTT 5 builders based on the connection's username and password.

methods.name: configureClientBuilder
methods.description: Sets up server host, port, SSL config, reconnection, and other properties on the MQTT client builder based on the connection details and protocol.
